parameters.query:
WITH holdings AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        quantity,
        COALESCE(average_cost, 0) AS average_cost,
        COALESCE(current_price, 0) AS current_price,
        COALESCE(sector, 'Unknown') AS sector,

        quantity *
        COALESCE(current_price, 0)
            AS market_value,

        quantity *
        COALESCE(average_cost, 0)
            AS cost_basis,

        quantity *
        (
            COALESCE(current_price, 0) -
            COALESCE(average_cost, 0)
        ) AS unrealized_gain_loss

    FROM portfolio_holdings
    WHERE user_id = $1
),

totals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS holding_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(market_value),
            0
        ) AS total_market_value,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(cost_basis),
            0
        ) AS total_cost_basis,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(unrealized_gain_loss),
            0
        ) AS unrealized_gain_loss

    FROM holdings
),

sector_allocation AS (
    SELECT
        h.sector,

        SUM(
            h.market_value
        ) AS sector_value,

        CASE
            WHEN t.total_market_value = 0
                THEN 0
            ELSE
                SUM(h.market_value) *
                100 /
                t.total_market_value
        END AS sector_percentage

    FROM holdings h
    CROSS JOIN totals t

    GROUP BY
        h.sector,
        t.total_market_value
),

positions AS (
    SELECT
        h.*,

        CASE
            WHEN t.total_market_value = 0
                THEN 0
            ELSE
                h.market_value *
                100 /
                t.total_market_value
        END AS portfolio_percentage

    FROM holdings h
    CROSS JOIN totals t
)

SELECT
    jsonb_build_object(
        'user_id',
        $1,

        'data_as_of',
        NOW(),

        'data_status',
        'Illustrative demo portfolio; prices are not live',

        'summary',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'holding_count',
            t.holding_count,

            'total_market_value',
            ROUND(
                t.total_market_value,
                2
            ),

            'total_cost_basis',
            ROUND(
                t.total_cost_basis,
                2
            ),

            'unrealized_gain_loss',
            ROUND(
                t.unrealized_gain_loss,
                2
            ),

            'return_percentage',
            CASE
                WHEN t.total_cost_basis = 0
                    THEN 0
                ELSE
                    ROUND(
                        t.unrealized_gain_loss *
                        100 /
                        t.total_cost_basis,
                        2
                    )
            END
        ),

        'holdings',
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'ticker',
                            ticker,

                            'quantity',
                            quantity,

                            'average_cost',
                            ROUND(
                                average_cost,
                                2
                            ),

                            'current_price',
                            ROUND(
                                current_price,
                                2
                            ),

                            'sector',
                            sector,

                            'market_value',
                            ROUND(
                                market_value,
                                2
                            ),

                            'cost_basis',
                            ROUND(
                                cost_basis,
                                2
                            ),

                            'unrealized_gain_loss',
                            ROUND(
                                unrealized_gain_loss,
                                2
                            )
                        )
                        ORDER BY
                            market_value DESC
                    )

                FROM holdings
            ),
            '[]'::JSONB
        ),

        'sector_allocation',
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'sector',
                            sector,

                            'sector_value',
                            ROUND(
                                sector_value,
                                2
                            ),

                            'sector_percentage',
                            ROUND(
                                sector_percentage,
                                2
                            )
                        )
                        ORDER BY
                            sector_value DESC
                    )

                FROM sector_allocation
            ),
            '[]'::JSONB
        ),

        'position_concentration',
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'ticker',
                            ticker,

                            'sector',
                            sector,

                            'market_value',
                            ROUND(
                                market_value,
                                2
                            ),

                            'portfolio_percentage',
                            ROUND(
                                portfolio_percentage,
                                2
                            )
                        )
                        ORDER BY
                            market_value DESC
                    )

                FROM positions
            ),
            '[]'::JSONB
        )
    ) AS portfolio_analysis

FROM totals t;
